lead.title: Google releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber, opens Fairwind program for trusted defenders
lead.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 3.8 Flash, its most intelligent Flash model yet, with 1M token context, improved reasoning, and enhanced coding for autonomous agents. A restricted Cyber variant targets autonomous vulnerability discovery and automated patching, available through the new Fairwind Program for national cyber authorities and critical infrastructure providers. Pricing holds at $0.75/$3.75 per 1M tokens through December 2026.

items.title: Post-training language models achieve gold-medal performance in coding competitions
items.summary: An end-to-end pipeline combining large-scale problem curation, synthetic reasoning traces, and super-specialization achieves gold-medal performance at IOI/ICPC level.

items.title: Discriminative world models outperform generative prediction for web agent planning
items.summary: Proposes discriminative world models that rank predicted web states from candidate actions, outperforming generative next-state prediction for test-time web agent planning.

items.title: From reweighting to rewriting: unlocking intervention effects of influential training samples
items.summary: Shows rewriting — not just reweighting — is needed for effective training data attribution; the proposed method outperforms influence functions on intervention tasks.

items.title: Dutch books for language models: LLM probability forecasts violate coherence axioms
items.summary: Shows that LLMs' probabilistic forecasts for life decisions violate coherence axioms (Dutch books), undermining trust in their world model consistency.

items.title: ByteDance Seed publishes research on self-evolving agent harnesses that score on harness quality
items.summary: ByteDance Seed published a paper on self-evolving agent harnesses that score on harness quality rather than just task completion, matching or exceeding human baselines in writing and ML experimentation.

items.title: New US export controls target Chinese access to remote AI servers in Thailand and Singapore
items.summary: The Trump administration considers closing a loophole allowing China to access advanced AI compute via remote servers, targeting Moonshot's Kimi K3 model trained via Nvidia-equipped infrastructure.

items.title: Nvidia's DLSS 5 launches today with NBA2K27 across all RTX 50 Series GPUs
items.summary: Nvidia confirmed DLSS 5 (3D-guided Neural Rendering) launches September 3 starting at 9 pm PT, available across all RTX 50 Series GPUs, laptops, and GeForce NOW.

items.title: Acer showcases RTX Spark compact desktop with 1 petaflop AI performance at IFA 2026
items.summary: Acer unveiled the SFF RTX Spark compact desktop powered by the NVIDIA RTX Spark superchip featuring up to 1 petaflop AI performance, 128 GB unified memory, and a 6,144-core Blackwell GPU for local agentic AI workloads.

items.title: Qualcomm and ASUS launch Pharmaceutical AI Agent running fully on-device for community pharmacists in Taiwan
items.summary: Qualcomm and ASUS jointly launched a Pharmaceutical AI Agent using Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme AI PCs and Cloud AI 100 Ultra edge boxes, running a 20B-parameter GPT-OSS model fully on-device for private prescription analysis.

items.title: Singapore HTX expands public-safety robotics with humanoid and underwater programs
items.summary: HTX showcased the OceanOneK underwater humanoid robot at Milipol TechX 2026 and plans to establish a humanoid robotics centre for high-risk land applications including hazmat handling and firefighting.

items.title: IBM and Confluent bring Granite time series foundation models into Confluent Cloud's Flink streaming engine
items.summary: IBM's Granite time series models are now directly embeddable in Confluent Cloud's Flink engine, enabling forecasting, anomaly detection, and semantic intelligence on streaming data without data science expertise.

items.title: Fable 5.1 World Modeling — open-source 3D world generation via AI agent swarms
items.summary: PhiloLabs released Fable 5.1 World Modeling, an open-source project demonstrating 3D digital twin generation through AI coding agents, including a full Union Square SF reconstruction with procedural facades and a camera-match QA pipeline.

items.title: Pirol CoOS — desktop app where an AI agent builds your CRM and ERP as local plugins
items.summary: Pirol launched CoOS, a local-first desktop app where an AI agent builds CRM, ERP, and HR systems as plugins directly inside the app. Includes a CLI version for terminals and SSH sessions.
